text: The dataset that detected the 2021 tree-cover loss is the "Global Forest Change" dataset, version GFC-2025-v1.13, provided by the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD). This is evident from the observation tool output, which states "observed: tree-cover loss year 2021" and lists the source as "Hansen GFC GFC-2025-v1.13". This dataset is also listed as one of the datasets used in the run metadata.
